title: Tape-Head Visits Under Seam Release
statement: Let $M$ be a machine, let $a$ be one of its states, and let $c$ be a configuration for $M$ in state $a$. For every time $t$ and every work tape $i$, the set of head positions visited through time $t$ by the seam-release machine started from $c$ with its state renamed into the left summand is exactly the set visited by $M$ started from $c$.
